answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the onyx graph. Re-attestations are stored in beacon and vertex lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 622 impostors cost 1750 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear.
